nom: Tatcha: The Rice Polish. Daily Non-Abrasive Exfoliator

segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin says the grains are the perfect size and texture, leaving her skin smooth and silky.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer with severe skin sensitivity reports using the product for about three years with no issues, saying it clears up acne and leaves her face glowing and clean; another describes it as a light scrub good for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: A 56-year-old reviewer who has used the product for years says it helps keep her aging skin looking flawless and that she regularly receives compliments on her skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer in her mid-50s who has used the product for years reports it helps keep her skin looking flawless, crediting it as worth the extra cost, though this is a personal impression rather than a measured result.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the exfoliation feels clean without leaving skin dry or tight, with one specifically noting no dryness or tightness afterward, especially when followed by a moisturizer.
concerns.spots: One reviewer mentions using the product to work on faded acne scars but had not yet seen conclusive results at the time of her review, after about five uses.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with severe skin sensitivity reports the product clears up acne with regular use.

aspects.libelle: Foams into a soft, gentle exfoliating texture
Small amount needed; bottle lasts a long time
Full-size dispenser can waste or shortchange product
Some buyers report receiving a suspected counterfeit

extraits.texte: Fake!!! Do not purchase. This is filled with what appears to be dishwashing detergent or borax. The top left small sample on my hand is the authentic, purchased from the company website as well as the container on the left. This product foams up like a soap and smells like detergent!!!! Do NOT buy! I have been using this for years and I can 100% day it is not the correct product. It’s a good fake box and contain but not authentic!!!!

extraits.titre: So Far, So GoodSo Far, So Good
extraits.texte: This exfoliator is very interesting in the way it works. It's like a grainy powder that you dissolve in water and it turns foamy. You then use it for 10-20 seconds, they specifically say 10-20 seconds in the directions. This makes me wonder what happens if you use it for a longer amount of time. lol. I've only used it accordingly, so I'm not sure. I am also not sure as to how this light liquid-y foam is supposed to exfoliate the skin, but I do enjoy the results. I've used it about 5 times and have noticed decent results. Right away after I wash it off I can tell my complexion is brighter and my skin smoother. I don't know how it does this, but it does it. It makes a great short term impression, but I'm going to wait out on the long term results, to see if it was worth the price. I have some faded acne scars that I'm working on, so we'll see how this does with that. The only other exfoliator I've used that has impressed me this much is the freemans charcoal and black sugar mask. That mask is on the opposite price range and has amazing results also, but that's if you don't mind sugar scrubs. Which is a total opposite of this soft foamy exfoliator. The downside to this product is the price. I mean, I looks as expensive as other brands at this price range, but we'll see if it is really worth it. The container is very smooth and pretty. The small purple thing-y protrudes out and is not a sticker, so that in itself tells me they must've put a pretty penny into the design of these c

I love Tatcha’s products and especially this polish. It works great on my combination skin and the grains are the perfect size & texture, leaving it smooth and silky. My only issue is the packaging: with this full size version, I always end up with much more product in my palm than I need. The dispenser hole is just too big. I also have this polish in travel size and there’s no such problem with it. Which is weird, because the size of the hole is identical! Must be because of the overall size & volume of the jar, the small one holds much less product = less pressure when tilted. So I settled on just refilling the travel size from the big jar. Speaking of, it would be great to have an option to just buy a refill and reduce plastic waste. For this product, it’s perfectly doable.
I have been using this product for years. I receive so many compliments on my skin. I am 56 years old and this product I believe helps keep my aging Skin flawless. So worth the additional cost.

Love Love Love this product, got a sample from Sephora and was obsessed with it. A little goes a long way(1.5 yrs and counting still on 1 btl ), crazy thick foam, mild rice sent, great daily exfoliation that feels really clean without feeling dry or tight. Leaves skin so smooth and buttery especially after putting on moisturizer.

I use this rice polish religiously. I absolutely love it. Been using it for about three years. Clears up any acne, and I have severe skin sensitivity. Makes your face glow and clean. I then follow up with the tatcha purple face cream. Make your skin look so plump & fresh. Absolutely love, tatcha skin care!

I bought the travel size the first time to make sure I liked and loved the polish effect. Bought the full size and top came loose when snapped it open. Product damp and more product in trial size. Is this all you should get? UPDATE: I'm returning the one I got and I received a replacement jar. Container was full this time so I'm happy with my purchase. I do love the product as it a light scrub and good for sensitive skin.

reserve: The review sample is small and most reviewers do not state a specific skin type, so segment and concern coverage rests on very few individual reports.
